prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: Spain gallery documentary master. Create a wide 16:9 night photograph of Plaça des Born and Ciutadella old town, Menorca at 01:14 local time on 24 September 2026. Public eye-level viewpoint within the long paved plaza near the central memorial, looking toward the historic sandstone town hall/former royal fortress and old-town approach. Key anchors: a slender nineteenth-century obelisk rising from the broad open square; warm ochre town hall and stately palace façades; narrow pedestrian streets and restrained Mediterranean street lamps. The cathedral must not be inserted into an impossible sightline. Mostly clear deep navy-black sky, calm empty plaza, dry paving, honest restrained lighting. No people, cars, market stalls, flags, modern towers, duplicated monuments, wet reflections, moon, stars, text, logos or watermark. Preserve the obelisk, town hall and plaza axis in a centered composition usable as 4:5.
